whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Tiger Fitness,

I noticed your gym has stellar 4.8★ reviews with 370+ happy members in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new membership inquiries.

Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, workout programs, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://tigerfitness.arclanestudios.space

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Tiger Fitness team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking and your amazing 4.8-star reviews in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services aur batch timings integrate karke live kar sakte hain."
